Name: Abandoned Power Plant
Description1: An abandoned man-made power plant. Now teeming with electric and other artificial Pokemon.
Description2: This place is the main source of Blank Disks, as well as other electric and man-made items.

PossibleWeathers.Name: None
PossibleWeathers.Description: No particular weather in this dungeon.

PossibleWeathers.Name: Flooded
PossibleWeathers.Description: The Power Plant is partly flooded this week. Expect water all over the floor.

PossibleWeathers.Name: High Voltage Arcs
PossibleWeathers.Description: There's a constant discharge of electricty around the Plant that may hit Pokemon.

PossibleWeathers.Name: Ion Deluge
PossibleWeathers.Description: The air is Ionized and smells funny. All Normal-type attacks become Electric-type.

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have disturbed a nest belonging to a mother $1. She'll do the best to defend it's babies.
BossEncounters.PostEncounterString: $1 has calmed down and is hiding with their babies. You proceed forward.
BossEncounters.Note: The idea of this one is a mon of current floor, slightly stronger (15% except speed) equipped, with 2 babies

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have crossed eyes with an angry $1. Apparently it's the boss of this parts, and you're in their territory!.
BossEncounters.PostEncounterString: $1 runs away scared, it seems you're the Power Plant Boss now.
BossEncounters.Note: Monster house inspired, there's a big boss from next floor with buddies from first floor, and the buddies keep coming

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have arrived to a huge room. An enormous $1 is in the middle, suffering. It seems the great energies of this place have overloaded it and it's out of control.
BossEncounters.PostEncounterString: $1 releases all of it's energy and recovers. It's extremely thankful.
BossEncounters.Note: Inspired on deepest trench mutant mon. This mon is huge, resistant and slow, it's a survival fight. TODO: Will be in high voltage always, open field and try to add the 'giant' tag for impact

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have crossed eyes with an angry $1. Apparently it's the boss of this parts, and you're in their territory!.
BossEncounters.PostEncounterString: $1 runs away scared, it seems you're the Power Plant Boss now.
BossEncounters.Note: Monster house inspired, there's a big boss from next floor with buddies from first floor, and the buddies keep coming

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You reach the power plant's generator. The energy in this room is out of control. In the center, absorbing most of the energy a titan made of pure electricity. Before you can react, it starts moving all over the place...
BossEncounters.PostEventString: As you defeat the titan, the whole power plant starts to make a deafening noise. Parts start moving and the Power Plant starts sparking. Better leave ASAP.
BossEncounters.Note: Regieleki with with either/and Deluge + Arcs. Make regieleki faster and fight a bit longer. Regieleki will be by itself

EncounterPool.PreEncounterString: In the recycle bin, you see a perfectly functional $1 inside.
EncounterPool.PostEncounterString: You pick it up and continue on your way.

EncounterPool.Note: Just a mon from next floor but has an item equipped which it'll use during the fight
EncounterPool.PreEventString: In the middle of a room, you find a $2, but it's being guarded by a $1.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: $1 runs away, you have taken its $2.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: Inside of a glass panel, a purple evolution crystal is connected to a number of cables. It whispers: YE WHO SEEK AWAKENING, LET US BEGIN.
You find an old first-aid kit.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: Your Pokemon have recovered some health.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old first-aid kit, but it only has enough medicine for a single Pokemon.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: You decide to apply it to $1, which is now fully recovered.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You reach a room with a lot of electrified cables hanging.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: A pair of cables shocks $1, who suddenly springs back to life!

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old first-aid kit.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: Your Pokemon have recovered from their status conditions.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: A young $1 appears in front of you and starts flexing. It's showing off!
EncounterPool.PostEventString: It decides to follow you, show you what it's made of.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You walk on top of a decrepit catwalk.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: It obviously was a terrible idea! You and your Pokemon have sustained a bit of damage.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You arrive to an area that is partly flooded.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: Unfortunately, a live wire is touching the water! $1 is electrocuted and is now paralyzed!

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You reach a room with a lot of electrified cables hanging.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: A pair of cables shocks $1, who gets immediately vaporized

EncounterPool.PreEventString: $1 is in the Abandoned Plant, as lost as you are. 'The only thing to do now is to battle!', they say
EncounterPool.PostEventString: $1 goes home defeated. You continue onwards.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old Automatic ATM machine on a wall.
You find some Team Paradox members carrying a crate full of blank disks. You are extremely suspicious of them.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: They give you $1 as a bribe to look away.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old lunch table. The perfect place for a picnic.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: But now it's time to move on...

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find Arven in a mess hall, he's just making some sandwiches.
EncounterPool.PostEventString: He shares a $1 with you, so you can try it next time you have a chance.
